_: Committed answers for the conformance stream. See CONFORMANCE-STREAM.md. Every substrate must reproduce every checksum it is run at. Several counts rather than one, so a divergence that first appears late is localised to a range rather than only to 'somewhere in a million'.

routine_counts._note: Python is capped lower only because it is ~1000x slower per case, not because it is trusted less: it is verified at 1000000 by hand and the result is recorded above. Raise it with STREAM_PY_ITERS.

zono_checksums._: The zonotope stream, kept separate so the checksums above stay a stable historical record. Carries one accumulator over shared and fresh symbols so condensation actually happens, and folds in the internal term list -- not just the interval -- because two substrates that condense differently can still agree on a width by coincidence.
